lead: This week in tech highlights innovative startups, significant VC deals, and advancements in AI, particularly within the Australian tech landscape.

stories.title: Flight Centre Global Leisure deploys AI agent to help build holidays
stories.summary: Flight Centre has introduced an AI agent designed to assist customers in planning their holidays. This innovation aims to enhance customer support options and streamline the holiday planning process, reflecting the growing trend of AI integration in the travel industry.

stories.title: Anthropic says it’s committing 5% of its shares to a ‘public benefit fund’
stories.summary: AI company Anthropic has announced a commitment to allocate 5% of its shares to a public benefit fund. This move highlights the growing intersection of corporate responsibility and AI development, aiming to ensure that advancements in AI technology benefit society at large.

stories.title: Disney agrees to hire the majority of Character.AI’s workforce
stories.summary: Disney has reached an agreement to hire most of the workforce from Character.AI, a startup known for its conversational AI technology. This acquisition could enhance Disney's capabilities in AI-driven storytelling and character interactions, marking a significant move in the entertainment tech space.

stories.title: What is Apple's Image Playground app for and how do you use it?
stories.summary: Apple's Image Playground app has received notable updates, allowing users to explore image generation and manipulation. This tool exemplifies Apple's commitment to enhancing user creativity through innovative software solutions.

stories.title: An Xbox Series X can now run PlayStation 5 games, but there's a catch
stories.summary: Gamers are now able to run PlayStation 5 games on the Xbox Series X through an emulator, thanks to the similar hardware architecture of both consoles. This development opens up new possibilities for cross-platform gaming experiences, though it comes with some limitations.

stories.title: Video game ownership bill introduced in Congress
stories.summary: A new bill, the Power To The Players Act, has been introduced in Congress to ensure consumers retain ownership of video games they purchase. This legislation aims to address growing concerns over digital rights and the impact of server shutdowns on game accessibility.

stories.title: Benchmark’s partners on investing in a frenzied market
stories.summary: Benchmark's partners discussed their investment strategies in a rapidly changing market, emphasizing a thoughtful approach amidst the frenzy. Their insights reflect the challenges and opportunities facing venture capitalists in the current tech landscape.

stories.title: Japan launches first-ever Mars-bound mission designed to come back
stories.summary: Japan's space agency, JAXA, has launched a groundbreaking mission to Mars' moon Phobos, with plans to return samples to Earth by 2031. This mission represents a significant advancement in space exploration technology and international collaboration in scientific research.

stories.title: TikTok reportedly banned ads for Musk documentary before its wider US release
stories.summary: TikTok has reportedly banned advertisements for a documentary about Elon Musk, citing political content restrictions. This decision raises questions about content moderation policies on social media platforms and their impact on documentary filmmaking.
